How to Use Recruitment Assist on Indeed

CrintellTech Recruitment Assist helps recruiters push candidate profiles from Indeed into the company database, add candidate notes, and identify duplicate profiles.

This article explains how Recruitment Assist works on Indeed and highlights its key features.

  1. 1
    Search for Candidates on Indeed

    Log in to Indeed and search for candidates using the available search options.

  2. 2
    Open a Candidate Profile

    Select a candidate from the search results to view their profile and check whether their contact information is available.

  3. 3
    Push the Candidate Profile to the Database

    CrintellTech Recruitment Assist automatically pushes candidate profiles into the database when the required contact information is available.

    If the contact information is not initially available, the profile can be pushed when the candidate responds to your offer and you receive a link to view their contact information.

  4. 💡Important

    The profile is pushed only when the required contact information is available.

  5. 4
    Add Candidate Notes

    When a candidate profile is pushed into the database, the Candidate Notes interface appears on the Indeed page.

    Use this interface to add relevant notes to the candidate's profile for future reference.

  6. 1.
    Automated Profile Push
    Candidate profiles are automatically pushed into the database when the required contact information is available.
    2.
    Duplicate Profile Notification
    A duplicate notification appears on the Indeed search results page for candidates already in the database whose profiles were previously parsed through CrintellTech.
  7. 💡Best Practices

    • Ensure you are on the correct Indeed candidate profile before pushing a resume.

    • Verify that the required contact information is visible and available.

    • Check for duplicate profile notifications before proceeding.

    • Refer to the workflow video if you need help identifying the relevant buttons or notifications.
